Peter, Look, when I first jumped into the race to beat Mike Lawler and flip NY-17, I really didn’t know what to expect. I knew that it was going to be a hard fight. We had an initial roadmap. But a lot of it was a shot in the dark. One thing I knew for sure: I would need a massive team behind me. Now, heading into the final stretch, we've built that team. A huge chunk of our budget comes from people giving $10 or $20 to emails like this one. And with that support, we’ve built an operation that has turned this Lean-R district into a tossup. Nate Silver calls us one of three races most likely to determine control of the House. I’m incredibly proud of that, and I hope you are too. Over 250 years our nation has gone through really dark times, really hard chapters. In these extraordinary moments, ordinary people rose up and chose to live with courage. They knew America and our democracy is worth fighting for. The ending to this chapter in American history is not yet written. Who we become, the values that define us, _that is up to us._ **We are the cavalry. We are who takes this country back.** It’s up to us to beat Lawler, flip NY-17, and take back the House for Democrats. I know we can do that, but we can’t do it without you. So I’m humbly asking you to make a donation today, to help us close out the final leg of this campaign. [If I can count on your support, use this link and make a donation today. Earlier this year, our team set ambitious goals for the midterms: elect Democratic pro-choice women across our widest U.S. House map yet, build Democratic power in critical states, and help lay the groundwork for a Democratic U.S. Senate majority.
**Now, with less than three weeks until Election Day, we’re seeing those ambitions become reality.**
We’re on offense in districts Republicans thought were safely theirs. We’re making races competitive that national observers counted out. And we’re seeing the power of early investments in Democratic pro-choice women who are ready to win.
None of this would be possible without supporters like you.
Republicans see what’s happening, too. And they’re not going down without a fight. Donald Trump’s super PAC and other MAGA-aligned groups are ready to spend _hundreds of millions_ of dollars in the closing weeks of the election to stop our momentum.
But we’ve worked too hard and come too far to let that happen. Our candidates have what it takes to win — and with your help, we can make sure they have the resources to finish the job.

clean_body: We can’t rest easy just yet | = Hey Peter, I’m preparing to head out on the road with EMILYs List candidates in Virginia and Ohio, and I wanted to take a moment to tell you something I’ve been seeing firsthand: All across the country, EMILYs List women are building the momentum to flip seats, win tough races, and deliver big victories for Democrats on Election Day. I’ve knocked doors in Michigan and Nebraska. I’ve mobilized voters in South Carolina and Florida. And everywhere I go, the energy is undeniable: Our candidates are competing hard. Supporters are showing up. And with just 19 days until Election Day,we’re winning. But we’re not taking our foot off the gas now. We’re going to fight for every last vote, in every last race, until the polls close on Election Day. = | = Earlier this year, our team set ambitious goals for the midterms: elect Democratic pro-choice women across our widest U.S. House map yet, build Democratic power in critical states, and help lay the groundwork for a Democratic U.S. Senate majority. Now, with less than three weeks until Election Day, we’re seeing those ambitions become reality. We’re on offense in districts Republicans thought were safely theirs. We’re making races competitive that national observers counted out. And we’re seeing the power of early investments in Democratic pro-choice women who are ready to win. None of this would be possible without supporters like you. Republicans see what’s happening, too. And they’re not going down without a fight. Donald Trump’s super PAC and other MAGA-aligned groups are ready to spend hundreds of millions of dollars in the closing weeks of the election to stop our momentum. But we’ve worked too hard and come too far to let that happen. Our candidates have what it takes to win — and with your help, we can make sure they have the resources to finish the job. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue, your donation will go through immediately: = | = ---|--- = | = = | = Thank you for being part of the team, Jessica Mackler (she/her/hers) President, EMILYs List | = | | | | | ---|---|---|---|--- Thank you for being a supporter of EMILYs List. Last week, a message popped up in my DMs that I've read about ten times since. It was from a man named Brett. He used to be a Republican. Now he's running for the Utah House as a Democrat, and he says I'm part of the reason why.
Brett grew up in a small town of 800 people. When Obama won in 2008, he says it felt like the world had ended.
He was a Republican, but his values came from the New Testament. Turn the other cheek. Speak truth to power. Love one another.

During the 2024 race, he started noticing the lies and the hypocrisy. Around that time, his fiance took him to a rally for a congresswoman he'd never heard of. I was the speaker who opened that rally. Brett told me it was the first time he ever listened to a Democrat with an open mind
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/84f5143f-07d0-4498-9deb-a78e67c2de1b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
.He walked out seeing politics in a whole new way. In his words, "it was no longer left versus right, but greed and power versus the people."
Today Brett Nielsen is on the ballot for Utah House District 51 in west side Utah County.
When I ran for Senate, I lost. Some days it felt like I'd climbed all that way just to get turned around below the summit. But Brett reminded me that a race doesn't end on Election Day. It's like tossing a stone in a lake. The splash is gone in a second, but the ripples keep going.
Brett told me something else I can't stop thinking about. "For me, winning is having a choice on the ballot." A ballot with one name on it is like a menu with one item. You're not choosing. You're just being served.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/00088986-0f55-47e7-bf9f-ba7bb651a3e5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
## A lifetime of Mike Lee
Here's why I'm pleading with you to vote and to text any of your friends in states with a Senate race. We have to stop a lifetime of Mike Lee.
In 2016, Lee refused to endorse Donald Trump. Ten years later, he's one of Trump's most loyal defenders, and his name keeps coming up for the Supreme Court. This spring, the Republican chair of the Senate Judiciary Committee called Lee one of his top two picks.
His record is hard to read without wincing. In June 2025, a gunman murdered Minnesota lawmaker Melissa Hortman and her husband. Lee posted, "This is what happens when Marxists don't get their way." Then he shared a photo of the suspect with the caption "Nightmare on Waltz Street," a jab at Governor Tim Walz. Even Republican senators called it inappropriate. He deleted the posts but never publicly apologized.
That same month, he tried to force the sale of up to 3.3 million acres of our public lands across 11 Western states. Hunters, hikers, ranchers, and members of his own party had to band together to stop him. Now picture that judgment with a lifetime seat.
Justice Samuel Alito is 76, and he says he'll think about retiring every year. If a seat opens, the Senate decides who fills it. Supreme Court seats last for life, and Lee is only 55. Lee has clerked for Alito twice and many consider him the heir to the seat. That could mean 30 years of rulings on your water, your public lands, and your right to vote.
Think of the Senate as the bouncer at the Supreme Court's door. Nobody gets in without its OK. Right now, Trump's party is working the door, and they'll wave in whoever he sends. Utah doesn't have a Senate race this year, but many of you live in states that do. Your vote decides who's checking.
My picks are below, state by state in alphabetical order, with Utah at the end. Find your state and vote down the list. There are so many great candidates on the ballot this year! I put this whole list into a voting guide on Sway so you can pull up your own races in one tap: https://www.sway.co/g/cfr9gtre?utm_source=share&ref=4iby3as5

Drop more in the comments and I'll add them.

clean_body: My 2026 endorsements, and why it will take all of us to win back the Senate | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more My 2026 endorsements, and why it will take all of us to win back the Senate | | | Oct 15 | | | | | | | | | | | | Last week, a message popped up in my DMs that I've read about ten times since. It was from a man named Brett. He used to be a Republican. Now he's running for the Utah House as a Democrat, and he says I'm part of the reason why. Brett grew up in a small town of 800 people. When Obama won in 2008, he says it felt like the world had ended. He was a Republican, but his values came from the New Testament. Turn the other cheek. Speak truth to power. Love one another. Caroline Gleich ⛰️ is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber. During the 2024 race, he started noticing the lies and the hypocrisy. Around that time, his fiance took him to a rally for a congresswoman he'd never heard of. I was the speaker who opened that rally. Brett told me it was the first time he ever listened to a Democrat with an open mind | | ---|---|--- .He walked out seeing politics in a whole new way. In his words, "it was no longer left versus right, but greed and power versus the people." Today Brett Nielsen is on the ballot for Utah House District 51 in west side Utah County. When I ran for Senate, I lost. Some days it felt like I'd climbed all that way just to get turned around below the summit. But Brett reminded me that a race doesn't end on Election Day. It's like tossing a stone in a lake. The splash is gone in a second, but the ripples keep going. Brett told me something else I can't stop thinking about. "For me, winning is having a choice on the ballot." A ballot with one name on it is like a menu with one item. You're not choosing. You're just being served. | | ---|---|--- A lifetime of Mike Lee Here's why I'm pleading with you to vote and to text any of your friends in states with a Senate race. We have to stop a lifetime of Mike Lee. In 2016, Lee refused to endorse Donald Trump. Ten years later, he's one of Trump's most loyal defenders, and his name keeps coming up for the Supreme Court. This spring, the Republican chair of the Senate Judiciary Committee called Lee one of his top two picks. His record is hard to read without wincing. In June 2025, a gunman murdered Minnesota lawmaker Melissa Hortman and her husband. Lee posted, "This is what happens when Marxists don't get their way." Then he shared a photo of the suspect with the caption "Nightmare on Waltz Street," a jab at Governor Tim Walz. Even Republican senators called it inappropriate. He deleted the posts but never publicly apologized. That same month, he tried to force the sale of up to 3.3 million acres of our public lands across 11 Western states. Hunters, hikers, ranchers, and members of his own party had to band together to stop him. Now picture that judgment with a lifetime seat. Justice Samuel Alito is 76, and he says he'll think about retiring every year. If a seat opens, the Senate decides who fills it. Supreme Court seats last for life, and Lee is only 55. Lee has clerked for Alito twice and many consider him the heir to the seat. That could mean 30 years of rulings on your water, your public lands, and your right to vote. Think of the Senate as the bouncer at the Supreme Court's door. Nobody gets in without its OK. Right now, Trump's party is working the door, and they'll wave in whoever he sends. Utah doesn't have a Senate race this year, but many of you live in states that do. Your vote decides who's checking. My picks are below, state by state in alphabetical order, with Utah at the end. Find your state and vote down the list. There are so many great candidates on the ballot this year! | | Peter, Indigenous Americans weren't recognized as U.S. citizens until 1924. Some states kept Native people from the ballot box for decades more — New Mexico didn't allow them to vote until 1948. That's within living memory. **Elders in Pueblo communities today were alive when their parents couldn't legally cast a ballot in their own homeland.** Now hold that history up against what's on the ballot in 18 days: **Mary Peltola** , fighting to flip the Senate seat the majority runs through. **Peggy Flanagan** , one race from becoming the first Native American woman ever to serve in the Senate. **Deb Haaland** , running to govern the very state that barred her people from voting until 1948 — as the first Native American woman elected governor anywhere. **Sharice Davids** and **Claire Valdez** , fighting for the House seats a Democratic majority needs. Five Indigenous women. The Senate, the House, and a governorship. And with your support, we will help all five of them win. clean_body: There are elders alive today who remember when this was impossible There are elders alive today who remember when this was impossible | ~~ | | Peter, Indigenous Americans weren't recognized as U.S. citizens until 1924. Some states kept Native people from the ballot box for decades more — New Mexico didn't allow them to vote until 1948. That's within living memory. Elders in Pueblo communities today were alive when their parents couldn't legally cast a ballot in their own homeland. Now hold that history up against what's on the ballot in 18 days: Mary Peltola , fighting to flip the Senate seat the majority runs through. Peggy Flanagan , one race from becoming the first Native American woman ever to serve in the Senate. Deb Haaland , running to govern the very state that barred her people from voting until 1948 — as the first Native American woman elected governor anywhere. Sharice Davids and Claire Valdez , fighting for the House seats a Democratic majority needs. Five Indigenous women. The Senate, the House, and a governorship. And with your support, we will help all five of them win. name: Abdul El-Sayed
subject: Good news and bad news
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Abdul for U
body:
Peter, I’ve got good news and bad news. I'll give you the good news first:
We have the winning message. Money out of politics. Money in your pocket. Medicare for All. I've been saying the same thing for more than a year, and it lands with Democrats, independents, even folks who voted for Trump.
I met an independent voter who told me his kid is really good at baseball but can't play next year, because he just can't afford it. That's who this campaign is for. That’s why a Fox News poll from earlier this month had us up 1 point over Mike Rogers.
But then there’s the bad news: MAGA money might make none of that matter.**
Mike Rogers has over $100 million from Trump, Elon, and the largest Senate GOP Super PAC to prop up his campaign and attack ours. He’s barely campaigning at all, and it’s no surprise as to why. **He thinks the money can simply buy him this Senate seat.**
I don't take a dime from corporate PACs, and I never will. I’m counting on grassroots support from folks like you to fuel this campaign and get our message across Michigan. So even though I don’t love asking, I have no other choice but to lean on you.
_**Please, can you pitch in $5 or whatever amount makes sense to you to help our campaign respond to the MAGA ads and win this toss-up race?**_

subject: Good news, Peter
body:
I truly couldn’t be more grateful – but now, it’s imperative that we stay on track.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1611&source=&t=1&akid=4383%2E124072%2E0WDixC) | | | |

Peter, I’ve got good news to share:
You might remember how a few days ago, I let you know that due to a dip in small-dollar donations, our campaign was forced to make some big cuts to our projections for October.
Well in the days since, grassroots support has made quite the comeback! I truly couldn’t be more grateful.
**Now, it’s imperative that we _stay_ on track.**
I understand that things appear to be going our way right now. From the most recent polls to the expert predictions, all signs point to us flipping North Carolina blue for the first time since 2008 – but it’s not a done deal yet.
In-person voting has officially begun here in North Carolina, and my team and I set a critical $500,000 goal to ensure we have the grassroots momentum to get the job done at the ballot box 19 days from now. So the worst thing we can do now is get complacent and come up short on tomorrow's goal.
**However, if I can count on just 27 more supporters from Englewood reading this right now to chip in $5, we’ll stay on course to reach it on time.**
I’m coming to you this evening in the hopes that you’ll be one of them, Peter, so please: [**_Will you pitch in that much or more to help us hit our $500,000 goal to reach more voters, flip this battleground seat and take back the Senate for Democrats?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1611&amount=5&t=8&akid=4383%2E124072%2E0WDixC)

clean_body: I’m concerned, but not in the B.S. way Susan was “concerned” on the debate stage. | | | | I’m concerned, but not in the B.S. way Susan was “concerned” on the debate stage for all four debates. I’m actually concerned, because despite four debates that showed just how corrupt and out of touch Susan Collins is, we’re still falling behind on our midnight goal. And we have just hours to reach it. ** During all four debates, Susan was “concerned” and “frustrated” when her bad votes, connections to Trump, and complete abandonment of Mainers were brought up. She can’t handle being held accountable for the consequences of her actions. The part that gets me the most is that Susan could actually do something about it if she wanted to. Susan Collins has voted with Donald Trump 96% of the time, then claims to be bipartisan. It’s no surprise considering that her corporate PACs and billionaire buddies have spent $60 million to defeat me. In the Senate, I’ll do things differently. This seat and your vote can only be earned, not bought. I don’t take any corporate PAC money, and I sure as hell don’t take your support for granted. I’ve known since day one that if we were going to win this race, it had to be from the bottom up, grassroots-powered through and through. And so far, we’ve made it work. We are catching up to Susan on the airwaves and in the polls. But tonight, we’re at risk of falling short of our $1,000,000 midnight goal. If we fall short, Susan will dominate the airwaves, and we will slip in the polls. name: Kailee Buller
subject: Peter, I saved your spot
body:
Your Victory Captain invitation hasn't been accepted yet.

| | | | |
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |
Peter, did you get my email the other day?
I looked over our Victory Captain list this morning, and I didn't see your name yet.
I know how busy life gets, so I wanted to make sure my invitation didn't slip past you.
With less than 20 days to go, there's no time to waste. The people who step up now will decide how this race ends. _**And I want you in that group.**_
Will you take ten seconds right now to accept your Victory Captain role?
[**ACCEPT MY VICTORY CAPTAIN ROLE >>**](https://us.list-manage.com/6x4NhQs7bmw?e=7e42b80a6c&c2id=65ca27defa2b2ff4fbda44443b52d843)
Saying yes means you're ready to stand with me through Election Day, helping your friends and neighbors get to the polls and making sure Central New York hears our message loud and clear.
**I'd be honored to add your name today, Peter.**
Kailee
\-------------------- FORWARDED MESSAGE --------------------To: dpwillis67@gmail.comFrom: Kailee

---
| |
Peter,
We are now 21 days away from Election Day.
When I started this campaign, I said it would be built from the ground up by the people of Central New York. You've been part of that from the start, and I'm grateful.
**But these final weeks are when races like ours are won or lost.**
Every conversation with a neighbor, every reminder to a friend, and every yard sign in a front lawn matters more now than at any point in this campaign.
That is why I'm asking you to become an official VICTORY CAPTAIN for Kailee Buller for Congress.
[**YES, I'LL BE A VICTORY CAPTAIN >>**](https://us.list-manage.com/18PWmAxZIkS?e=7e42b80a6c&c2id=65ca27defa2b2ff4fbda44443b52d843)
Here's what being a Victory Captain means...
Victory Captains are the people I'll count on most in the home stretch. You'll be the first to hear our closing plan, the first to get our final campaign updates, and the person your friends and family turn to when they want to know what's really at stake in this race.
_**We'll be counting on you to help make sure the people in your life have a plan to vote, to let us know who could use a yard sign, and to keep us in touch with what's happening in your corner of NY-22.**_
_**You'll be the reason voters who might have stayed home show up instead.**_
I'm running to lower costs, protect our communities, defend our farmers and small businesses, and make Central New York a place where our kids can build their futures. And I need people like you standing with me now, more than ever.
[ _So, Peter, will you be there?_](https://us.list-manage.com/Lsmahfyw1kI?e=7e42b80a6c&c2id=65ca27defa2b2ff4fbda44443b52d843)
---
| [I'M IN: SIGN ME UP AS A VICTORY CAPTAIN >>](https://us.list-manage.com/UjhoTt6smCu?e=7e42b80a6c&c2id=65ca27defa2b2ff4fbda44443b52d843)
---
| |
The clock is running, and I want my strongest supporters in place before the final push begins.
Thank you for being on this team. Let's finish this together.
Kailee BullerRepublican Candidate for Congress, NY-22

body:
Hi there, it’s
Jocelyn.

I just stepped off the debate stage after going head-to-head with my
far-right opponent for the final time before Election Day.

Tonight was the last time for voters to see my opponent and me
side-by-side, and the difference was crystal clear: I am in this race to
work for you. My opponent just wants to serve Donald Trump.

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/22100?amount=15&t=1001&akid=2013%2E181023%2EBuhH4V ]But the unfortunate truth is, it doesn’t matter that we won this
debate.
Because after tonight’s performance, Republicans are going to be flooding
this race to try to prop up John James and drown us out. We can’t let
them. Will you rush a
$15
donation tonight, or whatever you can spare, to help us meet this moment
and win this race?

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/22100?t=1002&akid=2013%2E181023%2EBuhH4V ]Donate →

Throughout our debates, my opponent has made it clear: he’s not trying to
beat our message — he’s just trying to outspend it.

While I’ve focused on my vision for how we make Michigan more affordable
and make government work for the people again — my opponent, once again,
spent the entire night trying to dodge his record and distort mine.

When asked to defend any of his votes in Congress, he couldn’t.

He couldn’t answer why he voted for the war in Iran six times, or endorsed
tariffs that are drowning Michigan families, or voted to cut Michiganders’
healthcare three times.

Because the simple fact of the matter is, he can’t break from the Trump
agenda that’s making life more expensive for Michigan families — it’s all
he has.

He’s hoping Trump’s endorsement, and millions of dollars from billionaires
like Elon Musk and the DeVos family, will be enough to win him this race.

And the truth is, he could be right.

With 19 days to go until Election Day, his far-right megadonors and shady
outside groups are cutting deceptive ads that will distort everything I
said tonight. With millions in their war chest, those attacks could be
blasting on every screen in the state by morning.

so I mean it when I say I can’t win this race without your support. So
please, if you believe in the future we’re fighting for, will you chip in
today?

He’s hoping Trump’s endorsement, and millions of dollars from billionaires like Elon Musk and the DeVos family, will be enough to win him this race. And the truth is, he could be right. With 19 days to go until Election Day, his far-right megadonors and shady outside groups are cutting deceptive ads that will distort everything I said tonight. With millions in their war chest, those attacks could be blasting on every screen in the state by morning. [ ]I’m not relying on billionaires and corporations to fund my campaign, so I mean it when I say I can’t win this race without your support. I’m concerned, but not in the B.S. way Susan was “concerned” on the debate stage.
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261015_4.TPFVPc&refcode=em20261015-4&t=1&akid=9560%2E582294%2EMxyzRr)
I’m concerned, but not in the B.S. way Susan was “concerned” on the debate stage for all four debates.
I’m actually concerned, because despite four debates that showed just how corrupt and out of touch Susan Collins is, we’re still falling behind on our midnight goal. And we have just hours to reach it. **[Will you chip in now to ensure Chris Pappas and I have the cash to defeat Susan Collins in 19 days?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261015_4.TPFVPc&refcode=em20261015-4&t=2&akid=9560%2E582294%2EMxyzRr)**
**[CHIP IN NOW »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261015_4.TPFVPc&refcode=em20261015-4&t=3&akid=9560%2E582294%2EMxyzRr)**
During all four debates, Susan was “concerned” and “frustrated” when her bad votes, connections to Trump, and complete abandonment of Mainers were brought up.
**She can’t handle being held accountable for the consequences of her actions.**
The part that gets me the most is that Susan could actually do something about it if she wanted to.
Susan Collins has voted with Donald Trump 96% of the time, then claims to be bipartisan. It’s no surprise considering that her corporate PACs and billionaire buddies have spent $60 million to defeat me.
**In the Senate, I’ll do things differently.**
This seat and your vote can only be earned, not bought. I don’t take any corporate PAC money, and I sure as hell don’t take your support for granted.
I’ve known since day one that if we were going to win this race, it had to be from the bottom up, grassroots-powered through and through. And so far, we’ve made it work. We are catching up to Susan on the airwaves and in the polls.
**But tonight, we’re at risk of falling short of our $1,000,000 midnight goal.**
If we fall short, Susan will dominate the airwaves, and we will slip in the polls. With just 19 days until the Election, we have no time to take a step back.
**[This is our one shot to flip this seat and the Senate, so we can’t fall short. So, as much as I hate asking for money, will you chip in before midnight to help Chris Pappas and me retire Susan Collins and her infinite “concern” once and for all?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261015_4.TPFVPc&refcode=em20261015-4&t=4&akid=9560%2E582294%2EMxyzRr)**

Solidarity forever,
Troy Jackson

body:
What to do when your ballot arrives.

---
| | Starting today, ballots are going out to every registered voter in Washington. Yours should arrive in the next few days.

When it does, I am asking you to do one thing: **Vote and drop it in a drop box!**

In this year's August primary, Thurston County Auditor Mary Hall reported that _70 valid ballots arrived after the certification deadline._ One took 19 days to be returned.

**Those voters did everything right, and their votes still did not count.**

Pierce County Auditor Linda Farmer put it plainly: there is "no guarantee that your ballot will be there on time."

**Voting is a fundamental right. It is not a privilege and it should not depend on how fast the mail moves. Using an official drop box takes that risk off the table.**

clean_body: What to do when your ballot arrives. | | Starting today, ballots are going out to every registered voter in Washington. Yours should arrive in the next few days. When it does, I am asking you to do one thing: Vote and drop it in a drop box! In this year's August primary, Thurston County Auditor Mary Hall reported that 70 valid ballots arrived after the certification deadline. One took 19 days to be returned. Those voters did everything right, and their votes still did not count. Pierce County Auditor Linda Farmer put it plainly: there is "no guarantee that your ballot will be there on time." Voting is a fundamental right. It is not a privilege and it should not depend on how fast the mail moves. Using an official drop box takes that risk off the table. | Two dates to keep handy: Monday, October 26: last day to register or update your address online or by mail. Tuesday, November 3: Election Day. Drop boxes close at 8pm. For the next 18 days, we will be working to make sure every voter in Pierce and Thurston counties knows how and when to return their ballot. body:

Peter,

Tonight is our [ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20261015-2-movement.49bv5X&refcode=em20261015-2827&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=2827%2E342411%2EuqwKlE ]final mid-month fundraising deadline before Election
Day. There’s no second chance at this one, and what we raise will power
the Squad through the last stretch of this race.

I’ve always said the people closest to the pain should be closest to the
power. That’s what our movement is about: making sure our communities
finally have a voice in the rooms where decisions about their lives get
made.

Alexandria, Ilhan, Rashida, and I have carried that voice into Congress.
We’ve fought for an economy that works for the people who build it, not
just the wealthy. For affordable housing and healthcare you don’t have to
ration. For reproductive freedom and immigrant rights. And we’ve never
backed down.

That’s exactly why Trump’s MAGA machine, corporate PACs, and party
insiders want every one of us gone. They know what happens when working
people organize. They know a movement like ours doesn’t just win elections
— it changes what’s possible.

But they’ve never understood where our power comes from. It doesn’t come
from corporate checks or insider favors. It comes from our brothers and
sisters working double shifts and still organizing on the weekends. From
neighbors knocking doors, making calls, and chipping in what they can
because they know what’s at stake. When we move together, we’re
unstoppable.

We’ve been told to wait our turn for far too long. We refuse to wait any
longer, and with less than three weeks to go, hitting this deadline is how
we keep our message in front of every voter who needs to hear it.

Peter: Will you chip in
$3 before midnight to help us hit our final mid-month goal
and power the Squad across the finish line?

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20261015-2-movement.49bv5X&refcode=em20261015-2827&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=2827%2E342411%2EuqwKlE ]Contribute ››

Ayanna

subject: Real patriotism: to love your country enough to fight to change it.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Deluzio for Congress
body:
What we are seeing – facing overwhelming odds – is record numbers of people contributing their time and their money to candidates and causes they believe in.
# [](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/46?t=1&akid=140%2E42639%2E7Uwwza)
There are corrupt and powerful forces in this country that work overtime to make it more difficult for regular folks to attain the American Dream.
They close mills and factories, they ship jobs overseas, and they have an insatiable desire for more and more while the working class of this country struggles to get by.
We can call them robber barons, we can call them oligarchs, or we can call them anything else you'd like ... but you know exactly who I am talking about.
They use their wealth and power to stack the deck against the working class of this country. They get richer and richer and use that money to buy influence in elections. They control so much of the political and economic life of this country, and even that isn't good enough for them.
Meanwhile, for the working class in this country it gets harder and harder to make ends meet.
In times like these, it can be easy for folks to feel despair and give up on the political process. But as I look around my district and around Pennsylvania, that is not what is happening.
What we are seeing – facing overwhelming odds – is record numbers of people contributing their time and their money to candidates and causes they believe in.
That's real patriotism: to love your country enough to fight to change it.
So thank you to all the patriotic volunteers turning out to knock doors, make calls, and help us win up and down the ballot in November!
[](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/28?c0=deluzio-em-26-q4.4eyHU-&refcode=em261016-volunteers&t=2&akid=140%2E42639%2E7Uwwza)
[](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/28?c0=deluzio-em-26-q4.4eyHU-&refcode=em261016-volunteers&t=3&akid=140%2E42639%2E7Uwwza)
In the history of this country, real change always comes from the People, not from those in power at the top. It only happens when people care enough to act in huge numbers to force change. That is the history of the labor movement, the civil rights movement, the women's rights movement and more.
And our challenge right now is to continue to show that passion through Election Day...but to then realize that after the votes are counted our work is not complete.
That is when it begins again.
That is what it will take if we are going to guarantee health care as a right for every man, woman, and child in this country; if we are going to overturn Citizens United; if we are going to make it easier to join a union; and if we are going to create a government that works for all of us, and not just the people who have never had it so good.
Let's get it done.
Don't give up the ship,
Chris Deluzio

clean_body: What we are seeing – facing overwhelming odds – is record numbers of people contributing their time and their money to candidates and causes they believe in. There are corrupt and powerful forces in this country that work overtime to make it more difficult for regular folks to attain the American Dream. They close mills and factories, they ship jobs overseas, and they have an insatiable desire for more and more while the working class of this country struggles to get by. We can call them robber barons, we can call them oligarchs, or we can call them anything else you'd like ... but you know exactly who I am talking about. They use their wealth and power to stack the deck against the working class of this country. They get richer and richer and use that money to buy influence in elections. They control so much of the political and economic life of this country, and even that isn't good enough for them. Meanwhile, for the working class in this country it gets harder and harder to make ends meet. In times like these, it can be easy for folks to feel despair and give up on the political process. But as I look around my district and around Pennsylvania, that is not what is happening. What we are seeing – facing overwhelming odds – is record numbers of people contributing their time and their money to candidates and causes they believe in. That's real patriotism: to love your country enough to fight to change it. So thank you to all the patriotic volunteers turning out to knock doors, make calls, and help us win up and down the ballot in November! In the history of this country, real change always comes from the People, not from those in power at the top. It only happens when people care enough to act in huge numbers to force change. That is the history of the labor movement, the civil rights movement, the women's rights movement and more. And our challenge right now is to continue to show that passion through Election Day...but to then realize that after the votes are counted our work is not complete. That is when it begins again. That is what it will take if we are going to guarantee health care as a right for every man, woman, and child in this country; if we are going to overturn Citizens United; if we are going to make it easier to join a union; and if we are going to create a government that works for all of us, and not just the people who have never had it so good. Let's get it done. Don't give up the ship, Chris Deluzio ☀️ Wait ... Before you click away! 🇺🇸 Chris Deluzio has won his elections in a competitive House district because of the support of grassroots supporters talking to voters, sharing information online, and donating what they can. If everyone getting this email contributed just $20 to his re-election, he would win this November with ease and put Democrats one step closer to taking back the House. Unfortunately, not everyone gives—so he's counting on people like you who know the stakes in this election to chip-in what they can. | A reporter asked Andy Harris about the Iran war. He threatened to have her arrested.
---
_You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=3526%2E259176%2EMzNcT1) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=3526%2E259176%2EMzNcT1)_

After my debate Tuesday night, a reporter asked my opponent, Congressman Andy Harris, the chair of the House Freedom Caucus, about his support for Trump’s war in Iran... and he had a full-blown meltdown.

He told her she was breaking the law by recording him, which she wasn’t, and threatened to have the police remove her. [](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/18712?source=SL_EM_FR_2026.10.16_DSchwartz-Reporter_B1_F1_S1_C1_180AC-360DON&t=4&akid=3526%2E259176%2EMzNcT1) If we haven’t met yet, I’m Dan Schwartz, and I’m running for Congress in Maryland’s First District. I’m a parent and a consumer watchdog, and I’ve spent my career holding banks and corporations accountable for regular people. Blue Amp Action told me I could reach out to you because we’re both in this fight to hold the far right accountable and flip the House for Democrats.

I understand why that question rattled him. Earlier that night, on stage, he blamed Democrats' environmental rules for the spike in diesel prices, and the room laughed at him. Everyone in MD-01 knows exactly when those prices took off. It was when Trump started a war with Iran, and Congressman Andy Harris backed it. | [DONATE $26 >>](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/18712?source=SL_EM_FR_2026.10.16_DSchwartz-Reporter_B1_F1_S1_C1_180AC-360DON&t=5&akid=3526%2E259176%2EMzNcT1)
---
Diesel runs MD-01. It's in the farmer's tractor, the waterman's boat, and the truck that stocks the grocery store, and all of them have been paying more since the war started. Harris would rather blame Democrats than say one word against the president who started it, and when someone asks him to, he calls for the police.

This is the same congressman who hasn't held an in-person town hall since 2023. He doesn't like questions from voters, and on Tuesday he made it clear he doesn't like them from reporters either.

**Our latest poll has us down just 1 point. Beating Harris takes the Freedom Caucus chair out of Congress and flips a seat that helps Democrats take back the House.

If you can, split a $25 donation with me and Blue Amp Action to support the Democratic ticket and help keep our ads running across the district through Election Day.**

_**A Special Message from our Sponsor**_ _Please note that views expressed in this message do not necessarily reflect those of_ _Free Speech Daily_ _and do not constitute an endorsement or recommendation by Free Speech Daily_ _._
---
| Jim Jordan But this urgent matter requires your immediate attention. | | Friend,
---
I know you get bombarded with a lot of GOP emails claiming to be “URGENT.”
---
Then, when you click on them, it’s just another fundraising request before an arbitrary midnight deadline or some other spam.
---
This isn’t that – I promise. I don’t use the word “URGENT” lightly. When I put it in the subject line of an email, I mean it!
---
I’m calling this “URGENT” because it’s both time-sensitive and about the single most important thing that will decide the midterms: **__Actual votes that have been cast so far!__**
---
**According to mainstream media reports, early voting numbers across several states show a significant shift towards the Democrats compared to 2024.**
---
**_CNN_ : “Early voting data shows emerging signs of a Democratic advantage in the midterms” **
---
**“In Iowa, Democrats have made 67% of ballot requests, up from 54% at this point in 2024. In Pennsylvania, it’s 66%, up from 62%, and in Maine it’s 57%, up from 53%. And according to data from the North Carolina State Board of Elections, 42% of ballot requests are from Democrats, up from 36% at this point two years ago.”**
---
Now, I want to be completely honest with you, so I’m not going to get carried away and declare that all hope is lost or anything like that.
---
At the end of the day, this is a very small sample size – about a million votes!
---
BUT... President Trump was very clear about what it’s going to take to defy history and WIN the midterms when he instructed Republicans to vote like _HE_ is on the ballot:
---
**“Pretend, please, that I’m on the ballot. Just come and vote. It’s so important.”**
---
**_Unfortunately, this early voting data shows that so far, Republicans are _NOT_ listening to the President and voting like they did in 2024 when he was on the ballot!_**
---
The reality is that we’re LOCKED in a razor-tight battle for the House Majority.
---
Any shift towards Democrats – _even just among the earliest voters_ – could be the difference between SAVING our Majority or losing it to a bunch of crazy Far Left radicals who will IMPEACH the President and plunge America into political chaos.
---
_That’s why my TOP priority in the final weeks of the election is to verify as many GOP voters as possible – and do it as quickly as possible – so we can ERASE any early advantage the Democrats have._
---
We need to know not only __WHO__ we can count on to show up and cast a ballot for Republicans, but also __HOW__ and __WHEN__ you plan to cast your ballot.
---
**_As part of my efforts, I’m asking _YOU_ to complete your FINAL verification of your voter profile and ensure all information is 100% up to date for Election Day._**
---
[**Please, before midnight tonight, complete your FINAL verification.**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwMzEsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA41lgdvpT0zFX5NopNGLurJPFRJrV5jjcVCTBK4Re8qOLCtISu02pcnez9Eau1M1G0Ji3tBPOd6N_2g2Js5Hi5L-BsT5FOrQ_VkK7_Y3)

body:
We’ve got a bunch of Veterans volunteering to text a bunch of other Veterans to make sure they turn out and vote
#
Peter, Travis from VoteVets here.
With three weeks to go, you’re probably wondering the same thing we are. How can I have the most impact ahead of this election?
Good news: There’s something the whole team at VoteVets is really excited about: Our Veterans-Texting-Veterans program.
We’ve got a bunch of Veterans volunteering to text a bunch of other Veterans to make sure they turn out and vote for VoteVets endorsed candidates on Election Day. And Peter, these texts can win us elections.
Here’s the situation: There are a few million registered voters scattered across the states and congressional districts that are going to decide which party controls Congress. These are people who need a push to turn out and cast their ballot. We’ve done this program before, and what we find in our after action reports is that the people we reach are significantly more likely to vote than the ones we don’t get to.
The big difference in what we’re doing versus everybody else is that we’re using Veterans to reach other Veterans. A Veteran’s more likely to respond when they know it’s another Veteran they’re talking to. It’s a big deal, and the only limitation we have is the resources we can devote to it.
Now, here’s the equation: Every $5 we raise is about 150 Veterans we can reach. $10, that number goes up to around 300. It stacks like that, and these donations end up adding up really quick when a lot of people are chipping in.
[**What do you think, Peter? Can you make a donation and help us reach the Veterans who are going to win us elections next month?**](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-oct26.xXsDMU&refcode=em261016-1-180&t=1&akid=35707%2E3013755%2EZaSzfF)

| | As we enter the final stretch of this campaign, Tom has been crisscrossing the district non-stop, meeting directly with voters and local leaders. Over the past several days, Tom joined neighbors across all six counties to celebrate our communities and hear directly from constituents. From celebrating heritage at the Clark UNICO Italian American Feast and Scotch Plains Day to meeting with downtown small businesses at the Somerville Street Fair, the energy on the ground is electric. Tom also spent time with local families at the Bedminster Fall Fest, teamed up with Mayor Piazza and Warren County neighbors for the iconic Phillipsburg Pork Roll Palooza, and fired up local volunteers at the Hunterdon County GOP Tailgate. To top it off, Tom visited with our brave volunteer firefighters and community members at the Stirling Firehouse Pancake Breakfast to reaffirm his unwavering support for our hometown first responders. Our door knocking program covered towns like **Bedminster, Belvidere, Bernards, Bloomsbury, Clark, Chester, Chester Borough, Clinton Twp., East Amwell, Franklin,****Green, Green Brook, Hillsborough, Holland, ****Hopatcong, Lambertville, Lopatcong, Milford, Mine Hill, Mendham, Mendham Borough, Mount Olive, Mountainside, New Providence, Pohatcong, Rahway, Raritan Borough, Readington, Roxbury, Scotch Plains, Somerville, Sparta, Springfield, Stockton, Summit, Union Twp., Washington Borough, Washington Twp. (Morris), **and**Westfield!** Kean for Congress continued our phone banking efforts with five organized phone banks this week. This week past we were able to call over __**20,000 voters**__ across all six counties. Want to join us? clean_body: Updates from our week in the field| | | | | Friend, | | With just weeks until Election Day, the race for NJ’s 7th District is only heating up, and the choice for our future couldn't be clearer. Mail-In Ballots are already sent out, and in-person Early Voting kicks off next Saturday, October 24th! Now is the time to get involved—whether that means knocking on doors, making phone calls, talking to your neighbors, or ensuring your family and friends have a plan to vote. Every single action we take right now will decide the outcome of this election and determine who fights for our values in Washington. Thank you for your tireless dedication, your generous support, and everything you are doing to keep NJ-07 RED. Check out all the ways you can get involved and review the full voting schedule below. Let's finish strong! | | | | | | | ✅ Kean Advocates for Over $1.9M in Funding for Somerville Downtown ✅ | | Last month, Tom secured $1,942,000 in federal Community Project Funding to transform downtown Somerville into a safer and more accessible downtown. The investment directly supports two local initiatives: the Division Street Arts Plaza and the Giardina Walk Improvements. This funding aims to bolster the regional economy, support local small businesses and restaurants, and enhance downtown Somerville's arts and cultural identity! “Downtown Somerville is truly the heart of Somerset County, and this investment will help make it an even better place to live, work, shop, and dine. I fought for this funding because Somerville deserves a downtown that reflects the energy, character, and pride of this special community. This project will be transformational in supporting local businesses, improving the downtown experience for residents and visitors alike.” \- Congressman Tom Kean, Jr. | | | | | | | Field Update | | | | | | | | | | As we enter the final stretch of this campaign, Tom has been crisscrossing the district non-stop, meeting directly with voters and local leaders. Over the past several days, Tom joined neighbors across all six counties to celebrate our communities and hear directly from constituents. From celebrating heritage at the Clark UNICO Italian American Feast and Scotch Plains Day to meeting with downtown small businesses at the Somerville Street Fair, the energy on the ground is electric. Tom also spent time with local families at the Bedminster Fall Fest, teamed up with Mayor Piazza and Warren County neighbors for the iconic Phillipsburg Pork Roll Palooza, and fired up local volunteers at the Hunterdon County GOP Tailgate. To top it off, Tom visited with our brave volunteer firefighters and community members at the Stirling Firehouse Pancake Breakfast to reaffirm his unwavering support for our hometown first responders. Our door knocking program covered towns like Bedminster, Belvidere, Bernards, Bloomsbury, Clark, Chester, Chester Borough, Clinton Twp., East Amwell, Franklin,Green, Green Brook, Hillsborough, Holland, Hopatcong, Lambertville, Lopatcong, Milford, Mine Hill, Mendham, Mendham Borough, Mount Olive, Mountainside, New Providence, Pohatcong, Rahway, Raritan Borough, Readington, Roxbury, Scotch Plains, Somerville, Sparta, Springfield, Stockton, Summit, Union Twp., Washington Borough, Washington Twp. (Morris), andWestfield! Kean for Congress continued our phone banking efforts with five organized phone banks this week. This week past we were able to call over 20,000 voters across all six counties. Want to join us? Use the SIGN UP TO VOLUNTEER button below and details will be provided. Want to get involved? Join us at some of our upcoming weekly events! | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | 🚨 ENDORSEMENT ALERT 🚨 | | | | | | Kean for Congress announced MAJOR endorsements recently! , , and all endorsed Tom thanks to his advocacy for good paying jobs, funding for law enforcement, and support of policies that cut the red tape for small businesses. Proud to have them on our team! | | | | | The time to vote is NOW!Important Dates Early Voting: October 24 – November 1 Deadline for In-Person Mail-In Ballot Applications for General Election: November 2 – by 3:00p Election Day: November 3 3 Ways to Return Your VBM Returns: 1. Mail it back 2. Place it in one of your county’s 3. Return it to your Early In-Person Voting, October 24 – November 1 Monday – Saturday: 10:00AM – 8:00PM Sunday: 10:00AM – 6:00PM You can vote at any voting location within the county where you live. No appointment necessary. Election Day, Tuesday, November 3 Polls open from 6:00AM – 8:00PM If you arrive at your polling location by 8:00PM, you can stay in line! ## Four Dead in Elementary School Shooting
At least three children and one adult were [killed Thursday](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFuhDAQBNCvgc7IXjgDhYs0dJc2JfJ5F3Cy2AibI_f30SWK8gGpRxrNm7freLWefZhf7UomT3EMdCamnGkfiWmlkO3-SG6JkdMSY_Zh5hEkaKGkUHq0Lvs7jY0t0UxEQHVJRrU9qOYitS4X00rqoJkAoesQXd-6um8d9EhtfYOLLr159imptJKyAV1N0tU1YoNAnbSXW9FIQp_jXr1HH_JCEz_infbKxbVks-S8paJ-KWAoYDjPs5ri59PxzAsYjlTAUAu3eMadglDC4sFZfHhmQhF3mmMQf1rxwxW_XpGOtJHLhGI-wmqDQLIotsjeUbkb3E7P7JNui0bOq_X8PSz_88-7ga8AAAD__4dSjpk) when a gunman entered Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Oregon, just before 1 p.m. PT. The suspected shooter is also dead. Police said the first 911 call reported a shot fired into a car outside the school. Officers arrived within three minutes and reported the shooter was dead. Law enforcement sources said the[ suspect was a 16-year-old boy](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0MFuhCAYBOCnwRsGftDVA4devG2vPRqEX6X5hQ1Qzb59s02aPkDPk8zkm4_7fLeBQtze7YGmrmmOeBXCWjHPSHhgrDY_i9tTorKnVEPcaAYBPZeCy362roYTZ20bb1ZEQNWgkbcRpO5E3ze7UVLjTS_jgKpT6J0eOrUKP4IdhtGBaIJ59UkheymEhr5dhVPKe-0BB2G7hWmBPtSU288UYt1xpWc6MbcuHQ2ZvdZHYeqNwcRguq6rdUt5OV45g4nCifzr4W3FwmBKGbcUeQl0YubZBuJ_Uv6L5AtGz2BqsvGPKxCF0t-YFtthA_0M13_-dRr4DgAA__8u7oJJ), shot by a bystander, though Bend police have not confirmed who fired. No names have been released, and Bend-La Pine Schools [canceled Friday classes](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0M1uhCAQwPGnwRsGEFEOHHrxtr32aPgYlQZhA6xm376x7aYP0Ns_mWQyv_m4zTftg4_ru95B1SXNEc4SoFbIMwTYIVadn8VuKYWypVR9XMPMCBOYEkzFrG31B8xcN04tAAy6BhQdJKO8J0I0mzKjoL1dpJS0H5nkVmsjqTNjr2XXc954de2jhApKCGeiXYjtOue4YzAS3RvECThfU24_k491gyU80wG5tWlvgtpqvRfUvSE2ITad59lGYy_HNUdsuhKx6VHwbwV_ADYhra9-3J2uULCB6HDKsKaI__T4h49ffpxt1IJ0gxyarNz99CH4IgbEybprH77Pqv_85qHYVwAAAP__n8aMUw) and athletic events districtwide. The district serves more than 16,000 students in Bend, about 160 miles southeast of Portland.
## Trump Scraps Execution Livestream
President Trump said Thursday the Pentagon [will not livestream](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDHO4yAUhE9jd1gPjElcUGzjLttuaWF4BFYYInixN7dfOVf4u5FG-kbf_HmsDxNTzM_fZkdNvqwZz5aQCOuKCXfMZOqn2VBKaqEUivmZVgFCMQ6Mq9VYigeu0vROe0SBY4-a32bB5QRK9UFvVppxxG02_ibdJOA-AzgPME4cYRZ91BePA1ccQAo1eLDj6Jx0Au9gpq2TgC5SqcPfEjMF9OlTDqyDLXufdCB6tW781YmlE8t5noPd2uVx9Z1YrtiJhep7fzFfKrFQimNfHawsR2cSC6aZzPAf2jfFklmKB7JGFc2F6Kt2rzOmFJu6dRKeu4npO08_fO3Q4n8AAAD__2E6hI8) the Dec. 3 execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan, reversing a plan Secretary of War Pete Hegseth announced earlier this month. A public stream "might have been a strong deterrent," President Trump [wrote on Truth Social](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1u8yAUxvGrgS0RHD4cDwyv9MpbOlXqaBE4xFTYWHCSKHdfubfQ9Xmk3_D_us5Xn0ve7h9-RUepzhu-ekEibDMWXHEj3949LLWWvtRKebuXGQTYkxQnaWcfKD9x1p5HlxABFUcnhxGkNsJavjhv8DZiNGOKN5WGoKJUMChjgjQJtOLZHZ4U0kohNNhzEkGpGHUEvAhvbkwLjJlqO3_XvNGCqbzrE9s51JUXtxDtnal_DCYGE7UHLb2G7MvxH6MWDX35Xzdf4md7rDuDaa-dOoNJykFro8Ro1QWsvRjDm4v7K5eSux2YFvfV51-K0x8LPR38BAAA__8UTnnH), "but many very good and well meaning people would rather not watch him die." Hasan will still face a firing squad, and victims' families may attend in person. The plan had drawn [bipartisan resistance](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHOozAQBOCnMR2RbcBA4eIaulx7JdqwS7wnY0f2Hrm8_S_-V_jrT5rRzJ_7egeOnJ6_4SAve14TvWskESorRTooCZRP3ULOsYachdMzrlZb1xrdGrfCJnzS2kODfiey1DXkzThb0w_auSZ4GobpgTjTPMLcY4dmmnbAvXNm2BHmhv2VZ7RxRuveutuut65D7NHSpGF4qF4TsuRy-5s5SaA9fvJJ5bblo4k-iLyq6n4puyi7SKDAMV6m7BLyQdckZRfAgxNXKSCck7KLM4N249AGqJBa-k_bv0valKWNfFKVQnAQKrs0xePrzTFydaPq9fMA_q5o5Ievnd5-BQAA__-jSYQ0), with GOP senators warning it would put the U.S. on the level of terrorist groups that broadcast killings. The Pentagon says Hegseth supports the decision. Hasan killed 13 people and wounded 32 at the Texas base in 2009. His execution will be the [military's first since 1961](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFvwyAQBeBfY29YcMa4GRi6ZEvXjhYxh7kKQwSXRP73VaL-g-6f3tN735fl4ihR3r7cjpZDWTI-W0JmrAsm3DGzq0dbYympxVKY8pYWkGCEkkKZxa1MD1y0670NiIBjj1bNJ1B6ksb00YbZzNfpihrQhBMoM07gjZFyDYAn73uyrzwllVFSajBDkOs4eq894Id007XTEj1xqcNPocwRQzrKA-uwlr1PNjLfWjd-dnDu4OzRcbxhdokPyqEMpW4dnO-iiZ0SveaItxF_SAS3chMuexFou1dsfbX-9qSUqJm503LbHaV3Gf_zo4eF3wAAAP__tHt-sQ), and its first by firing squad since 1945.
## Timekeepers Vote to Retire Leap Second
The world’s timekeepers [voted Thursday to retire](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuwyAURb8Gb1iPZ0LsgaGLt3TtaBF4DlQYIvNkK39fpUN_oOu90tU95-u23FzKqTw-3UaW17oUOlsmZtoXyrRRYbe_mo-15hZr5VQeeUFAIxVIZRbnOR20aNcFuxIhDR1ZdZ1Q6QsY00W7OoLJGTXiMKAb75PSMGmaRuNRjzR1yb73FCijADSafgU_DCHogDSCu9yFBgqJ695_11Q40ppf9aC993Xrso3MzyaGD4GzwPk8z_7lYq3vVuD8BhI4N5-oeBI4u52Tz_QXcmrc5FGZJJUgM7mnbORrCU0q1AAACvvIW-52G55nyjk1cxUaHptL-fcE_9PdYfEnAAD__z2jhGg) the leap second, the extra tick added to clocks 27 times since 1972 to keep atomic time in step with Earth’s wobbly spin. Delegates from 69 countries approved the change at a conference near Versailles, France. Earth’s rotation has been [gradually slowing](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGOqzAQQE9jOpA9GJMULn5Dl99uiWbxAI6MJ7JHoNx-lb3CXuA9vff1mB8YU8zbfzzIy8pzpqsmEqEyU6KDsmB512VnTnVnlpi3NIMG1xrdGjfjIvGk2WIT_EoE1DfkzXgHYwftXLN7fQsaRxjtvV8HHFawzg13skjW2OB0E_2HZ7RxRmsLrlv10vch2AB00zh8K6spROHSPTlm2WlNbz6pdAsfTfK7yKuq_p-CScF0XVf3fKUuY8Vu41PB9GlSMBEW2WsbMKZ3W1hQIue2Jr5i3hRMTfHhdcWUYnWjsno7MKZfh_xxzenhJwAA__9Hrnnb) for millennia, mostly from the pull of the moon, but since about 2020, it has sped up. That raised the prospect of a never-before-tried “negative” leap second that could crash software. Leap seconds in the past have knocked out Reddit and Cloudflare, since programs assume time only moves forward. In 2022, the measurement body agreed to [drop them by 2035](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFurDAQANDTmA5kD8bsFi5-Q7e_TYkMHmAi40FmAtrbR8kVcoFXvI_X-AqUKK__w45eFh4z3mdCESwjJtwxSyjvc96Y07kxC-U1jaDB1UbXxo1hFrpwtKGKfkEEbCv0pn-CsZ12rtp817UuPvve9O0Tpg5wMv1DW5imzqAxsSL_4xltnNHagmsWPbdtjDYCPnToJmU1RhIuzSdTlg2X9OYLSzPzXiW_iRynav8pGBQM9303Ex17w2VVMGBWMMzrsdegARQMBU9OX0Kca1sVH4-bUqLT9crqdQ-UflX5Y8bl4TsAAP__199zAg), and the speedup pushed the timetable up to 2027. The replacement is a “[leap hour](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGO6yAQheGnsTtHA8Y4Lihu4y633dIiMBhWYyYyo0R5-1X2FbY9R_qK_-u23XyhUvf__kAnibeKr0YogueGhAdW8ee7hcxMLTNLqTttGrQdFAzKbj5IeeJmfB9dQtQ49ujUvGhlJrC2zw5mmMZ5SsuS7vMy-Tlcr6M1k0ppgRhsX9zHU6CsAjDaXhKEcYzRRI1X8NO9M4CxCJ-Xby5VMiZ68xPPS-CjJ5dFHq0b_3V67fRa8eWFfPucnV4FQ65MvL87vRL6x9AwcI1tyKUJn5-5P118vApRaXbuDOyHL_SLyx-bPJ3-CQAA__8fUneF),” added only when clocks and sunrise drift an hour apart, which at the current pace could take more than a thousand years.

Trump Scraps Execution Livestream President Trump said Thursday the Pentagon the Dec. 3 execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan, reversing a plan Secretary of War Pete Hegseth announced earlier this month. A public stream "might have been a strong deterrent," President Trump , "but many very good and well meaning people would rather not watch him die." Hasan will still face a firing squad, and victims' families may attend in person. The plan had drawn , with GOP senators warning it would put the U.S. on the level of terrorist groups that broadcast killings. The Pentagon says Hegseth supports the decision. Hasan killed 13 people and wounded 32 at the Texas base in 2009. His execution will be the , and its first by firing squad since 1945. Timekeepers Vote to Retire Leap Second The world’s timekeepers the leap second, the extra tick added to clocks 27 times since 1972 to keep atomic time in step with Earth’s wobbly spin. Delegates from 69 countries approved the change at a conference near Versailles, France. Earth’s rotation has been for millennia, mostly from the pull of the moon, but since about 2020, it has sped up. That raised the prospect of a never-before-tried “negative” leap second that could crash software. Leap seconds in the past have knocked out Reddit and Cloudflare, since programs assume time only moves forward. In 2022, the measurement body agreed to , and the speedup pushed the timetable up to 2027. The replacement is a “,” added only when clocks and sunrise drift an hour apart, which at the current pace could take more than a thousand years. | | | | | | Early voting is underway in Indianapolis!
**While Andrea won't be on the ballot until the May 4, 2027 primary, there are important elections happening right now.**
Here's how you can make your voice heard this November.
---
|
---
|
---
| | All registered Marion County voters can vote at any early voting location in the county.
**October 6th – November 2nd:** Indianapolis City-County Building (ends at noon on November 2nd).
**October 24th – November 1st:** Additional early voting locations throughout Marion County.
**November 3rd:** Election Day. Voting takes place from 6 AM to 6 PM at [**Vote Centers**](https://us.list-manage.com/12L7V_lwxcd?e=d9ebccf591&c2id=f837219caea6b1298c44345ce9af78e8) across the county. Once you are in line, you cannot be turned away.
You'll need a [**valid photo ID**](https://us.list-manage.com/RfLA73URZc3?e=d9ebccf591&c2id=f837219caea6b1298c44345ce9af78e8) to vote in person.
---
|

---
|
---
|
---
| | If you qualify to vote absentee by mail, you can request a ballot online.
**October 22nd:** Deadline to apply for an absentee ballot by mail.
**November 3rd, 6 PM:** Deadline for your completed ballot to be received by the [**Marion County Election Board**](https://us.list-manage.com/ckamUXfsGVs?e=d9ebccf591&c2id=f837219caea6b1298c44345ce9af78e8). It can be delivered by mail or in person. You can also deliver your ballot in person to any early voting or Election Day polling location.
---

---
|
---
|
---
| | Whether you're voting early, by mail, or on Election Day, participating in our democracy is one of the most important ways we can help shape our communities.
Andrea's name will be on the ballot next spring, but your voice matters in every election.
Make a plan, cast your ballot, and encourage your friends and neighbors to do the same!

## Trump Drops Execution Livestream
President Trump said Thursday the Pentagon [won't livestream](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LEOnDAQBNCvgc7INmAfhYs0dJc2JVrwclgxXmTvAfn7iPxC-tFo3vx6T28IMaTPT9jR8b3SlPAqEZkxTx68xxhOzKVQCumA_DukT6RJS22EkkKZCRYOJ04d1N7N0g-qRqfsoFX36l-23pxuW9SwmN4u_apmQGnlPPR29qtXYE0d3FOnpDJKyVZ2jTXry_TSyq5b7NAPVSfRB6bc8IaMN5Q1_qETc7PQXke3MR-lan9Ueqz0eF1Xs9KtzUbfwpSeUKXHx1XpkfN3P8SDKpwRdrFSZrEReVE2IsYsUvAQxQYFUhF44_LlQKnOzh9XiDEUY6tOfnYI8d8A_t_jTqf_BgAA__8-hoYy) the Dec. 3 firing-squad execution of Nidal Hasan, the former Army psychiatrist who killed 13 people in the 2009 Fort Hood shooting. Trump [called off the stream](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGupSAURb9GOwwgChYU09i9aac0CMfryUMwcJ7e-_cT5xem3FnJzsr687V8OYyYXr_dAZbeW14S3DUCEZQluBAg4gWl1pwwna58Y3rFvEguRyY4E-PiPOEFi3JtsCsPk2jBCj1JocxgdLtb7swwbVqswP3mjeGrUKHXBsCE3kto0T53gotRCN5z1elxM-PANVfK62mYGsUhIOXS0Q4Eb1e3-MkXlM7no412Jzpr0_9q5NzI-b7v7rtgpevBjZzPHJHQ10bOtAM7C1QMkOjZ5ec4WXWfyuAN_ocwJ5Y3tuVCbM85sMPVyuqeM0FhN8bIUia2Anu6sEoF3AGhLTacD8U66kbx1-Ew_rOj_616Wfk3AAD__yo6kN8) in a social media post, writing that showing the world how America deals with "Terrorists and SCUM like Hasan" might have deterred others. But he said many people "would rather not watch him die." During the drive to the hospital, however, Emma could [barely sit in the car](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGu4yAUBNCvwR3WhWBjCopt3GXbLS1sLjFaAhbctZO_X-VJ7wtePdJozvy5L3cXU8yP3-6Jll6hLBmvlpAI6-Kd95jiibW1kmM-XP0b8yOVRYIcuQAuxsVtFE9clOu8XcEb0aEV2kihpmHS3W6FlwDTqjAIvRkwLsAmpjWIAUZlDHbRfuoEiFEIuIHq9RimcQANSm3aDIYpQB-p1J52JHy5FtK7nFj7rTy7ZHeio7HbLyZnJufruvq8bj5cn5jJ-SNick5lc4nJ-UguF-6d5984vsfGy5X56tY3d4Gw8r20I5JLnGo8eMyEtf47CD2TswIjQE9Mzl21_rhiSrGNmil4PF1MX6vop2-eVv4PAAD__6Pwios). A red light about five minutes from the hospital refused to turn green. Diego Contreras ran inside to alert ER staff, but when he got back to the car, Emma told him, "_He's here_." Mom and Beni are doing well, and Emma's wish that Diego be more involved this time came true. "_We didn't mean it like this, but I was really proud of him_ ," she said.

# [](https://act.electjon.com/go/4629?t=1&akid=3100%2E5691347%2Ejqsr5h)

Peter,
It's official.
Polls are open in Georgia, and I just cast my ballot in this pivotal midterm election.
[](https://act.electjon.com/go/5243?c0=ossoff-em-oct26.FRbHBd&refcode=em261016-1-subs&utm_campaign=em261016-1-subs&t=2&akid=3100%2E5691347%2Ejqsr5h)
_Now, my team needs to mobilize and persuade millions of voters across Georgia to do the same._
**_[Could you rush $5 to my reelection campaign today to make this massive mobilization effort possible?](https://act.electjon.com/go/5243?c0=ossoff-em-oct26.FRbHBd&refcode=em261016-1-subs&utm_campaign=em261016-1-subs&t=3&akid=3100%2E5691347%2Ejqsr5h)_**
**[DONATE](https://act.electjon.com/go/5243?c0=ossoff-em-oct26.FRbHBd&refcode=em261016-1-subs&utm_campaign=em261016-1-subs&t=4&akid=3100%2E5691347%2Ejqsr5h)**
I wanted to take this moment to tell you about my decision to run for Senate back in 2020, and what that race tells us about our path to victory.
Six years ago, I decided to run for Senate because I saw the danger in electing someone so profoundly unfit for the presidency, and I wanted to confront the corruption that made his rise possible.
The pundits and pollsters counted me out. They didn't think it was possible to unseat an entrenched Republican incumbent in Georgia.
But this team built one of the largest statewide campaigns Georgia had ever seen. And with your help, alongside Rev. Warnock, we won and secured the Senate majority for the Democrats.
We FLIPPED Georgia when nobody thought it was possible.
**Now we have to do it again, in the pivotal, must-win Senate race — a race I have always expected to be one of the closest and most expensive in the country.**
I don't love asking for money. I don't think anyone does. But the reality is I can't win without you. So I wouldn't be asking again if it didn't make a huge difference for my chances next month.
**_[So, Peter, can I count on your support again? Every single donation right now makes a real impact on our ability to organize and WIN.](https://act.electjon.com/go/5243?c0=ossoff-em-oct26.FRbHBd&refcode=em261016-1-subs&utm_campaign=em261016-1-subs&t=5&akid=3100%2E5691347%2Ejqsr5h)_**

Friend,
---
Charlie said it best in the days leading up to President Trump's victory in 2024: _" I don't care about polls. __ __I don 't care about betting markets. __ __I don 't care about vibes. __ _ **_I care about how many ballots are in the box. _**_ __If we turnout, we win. __ _**_Do the work. " _** Do the work... Charlie knew there was no easy route to saving our country. He knew there were no shortcuts to victory. He wore a red band on his wrist every day -- a reminder of what it would take -- that read, _**" Be Better. Work Harder." **_ It wasn't just for motivation. Charlie lived by those four words, and he expected every one of us at Turning Point to live by them too. name: Teichert in the Trenches
subject: 💥World Class Risk Management💥
body:
Test pilot Wilbur Wright warned about
---
| | | | | |
---
| | 💥World Class Risk Management💥
Test pilot Wilbur Wright warned about the challenges of pursuing powered flight when he said that “the man who wishes to keep at the problem long enough to really learn anything positively must not take dangerous risks. Carelessness and overconfidence are usually more dangerous than deliberately accepted risks.”
In this statement, Wilbur explicitly warns against taking dangerous risks. Yet, there is an implied nugget of wisdom in this quote that leaders must not neglect. He suggests that positive progress requires professionals to take carefully considered and deliberately accepted risks. Wilbur Wright never says to avoid all risk, only to avoid unsound risk.
It is not the job of a leader to avoid risk. In fact, a leadership mindset and organizational culture that avoids risk is rotten and stagnant.
Ironically, taking no risk is actually risky – setting up an organization for failure when they are inevitably surpassed by others who refuse to stand still.
The key then is to take the right risk – or as Wilbur Wright would say – take deliberately accepted risk. How?
French visionary Louis Pierre Mouillard was a hero to the Wright Brothers. This aviation pioneer boldly tackled his passion for aviation as both a fanciful artist and cutting-edge inventor. Mouillard’s aviation intellect was decades ahead of its time, and his writing, thinking, and drawing provided powerful inspiration for all who were pursuing powered flight.
In the closing paragraph of his brilliant 1881 book – L’Empire de l’Air – Mouillard wrote the following: “Finally, I counsel the greatest possible prudence to all who undertake to solve the problem of sailing flight. Let them carefully canvass all the causes of accidents which it is possible to foresee; but once they have made this canvass, once they have completed their researches, I recommend them to act with energy and will, and I know of no better word to say to them than the one with which I began this monograph: ‘Osez’ – daring wins!”
Like Wilbur Wright, Mouillard recommends that those pursuing aviation milestones should embrace the greatest reasonable prudence. Pioneers and leaders are to be cautious, not reckless. But, more explicitly than Wilbur Wright, Mouillard goes on to promote an informed and bold measure of risk-taking to promote progress. He tells leaders throughout the ages to adequately assess and mitigate risk, and then be bold in their pursuits. For Mouillard, a two-word phrase sufficiently captures the characteristic that properly promotes progress – Daring Wins!
Let me provide two short rubrics to consider when encountering and considering risk that align with the mindset promoted by the Wright Brothers and Louis Pierre Mouillard.
The first is the four-step process to properly manage risk:
* What are the areas of risk? (Assess Risk)
* How does the team properly mitigate those areas of risk? (Mitigate Risk)
* Who is the right approval authority to accept the remaining, unmitigated risk? (Accept Risk)
* Execute the plan with bold professionalism. (Embrace Risk)

The second is a six-step methodology in considering a new idea that could introduce risk:
* What problem are we solving?
* How does the new idea compare to foundational principles?
* What do designated experts think about the new idea?
* What are the risks and costs to implementing the new idea?
* What authorities are required to make the change?
* Is there some middle ground between the new idea and the status quo that is better than either?

World class risk management is a key component of success. Don’t avoid it, but instead deliberately accept it (and standby for more risk management thoughts in next month’s newsletter). With a proper understanding of risk you will be able to LEAD WELL and your team will soar.

* John

Carelessness and overconfidence are usually more dangerous than deliberately accepted risks.” In this statement, Wilbur explicitly warns against taking dangerous risks. Yet, there is an implied nugget of wisdom in this quote that leaders must not neglect. He suggests that positive progress requires professionals to take carefully considered and deliberately accepted risks. Wilbur Wright never says to avoid all risk, only to avoid unsound risk. It is not the job of a leader to avoid risk. In fact, a leadership mindset and organizational culture that avoids risk is rotten and stagnant. Ironically, taking no risk is actually risky – setting up an organization for failure when they are inevitably surpassed by others who refuse to stand still. The key then is to take the right risk – or as Wilbur Wright would say – take deliberately accepted risk. How? French visionary Louis Pierre Mouillard was a hero to the Wright Brothers. This aviation pioneer boldly tackled his passion for aviation as both a fanciful artist and cutting-edge inventor. Mouillard’s aviation intellect was decades ahead of its time, and his writing, thinking, and drawing provided powerful inspiration for all who were pursuing powered flight. Faith is essential to the survival and success of America.

Charlie Kirk staked his life's work on that truth.

He went straight into the hardest places in our culture and said what too many others were afraid to say, even when the crowd was hostile and the odds were against him.

He understood that if America is going to be renewed, the next generation has to find its way back to faith, truth, and love of country.

That's one reason JD Vance's story meant so much to him: Charlie saw in the Vice President something rare in public life -- a man whose faith had been tested, shaken, and ultimately rebuilt.

**That journey is what JD Vance writes about in his new book,_Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith._**

Peter, this book isn't just about JD Vance's story...

It speaks to something much bigger happening in our country right now.

So many Americans know what it feels like to live in a culture that is constantly pulling them away from what matters most -- away from faith, from family, and from the values that once held this country together.

Young people face that pressure every single day.

They're told faith is outdated. They're told truth is whatever feels right, or whatever the culture says it is.

JD Vance knows what it is like to live in that confusion.

He knows what it is like to search, to be shaped by a broken culture, and by God's grace, to find his way back.

That's what _Communion_ is about...

Acclaimed Christian country music songwriter Ben Calhoun, frontman of Citizen Way with multiple #1 songs. "Three S" songwriting philosophy: scriptural, singable, and simple. By focusing on these elements, he hopes to create a universal message that resonates with everyone from regular churchgoers to those seeking a deeper connection with their faith. One of the song's most poignant lines, "Every mountain is just another way to see how you move them," reflects Calhoun's belief in God's provision even in the face of difficulty.
Look for "Savannah's Pajamas" his 2023 children's storybook and companion single...Mission Aviation (MAF) provides aviation services to more than 400 mission agencies, churches, and humanitarian organizations around the world. Without MAF, some of these organizations would be unable to reach the people they serve. https://maf.org/ben-calhoun/

This isn't your typical fundraising email.
In a moment I **need to ask if you can chip in to my campaign,** but first I wanted to give you a look at what's happening on the trails as we gear up for November 3rd.
Here's the rundown:
At the end of September, we met with Democratic groups across New Hampshire. Their support is critical to winning this election.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/56f772e7-8053-42e7-9fd6-d005bc939f2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/56f772e7-8053-42e7-9fd6-d005bc939f2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Then we welcomed Pete Buttigieg back to the Granite State. With 18 days to go, we need everyone on board to help us win this thing.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/56f772e7-8053-42e7-9fd6-d005bc939f2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/56f772e7-8053-42e7-9fd6-d005bc939f2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
More recently Senator Reverend Raphael Warnock helped us open up a new campaign office in the Keene area. Just look at that packed room!
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/56f772e7-8053-42e7-9fd6-d005bc939f2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/56f772e7-8053-42e7-9fd6-d005bc939f2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
We're building the kind of grassroots movement it takes to win a swing state like New Hampshire.

There's one problem: **We are up against a mountain of cash that Republicans are spending on the airwaves.** It's nearly impossible to keep up with, but if we have enough small-dollar donations, we can outwork them.
We can't win this thing without the grassroots support of folks like you.
So I need to ask one more time: **[Will you chip in $5 or any amount today to help us defend New Hampshire's Senate seat? Every dollar donated will go directly towards stopping the GOP from flipping the Granite State red.](https://substack.com/redirect/56f772e7-8053-42e7-9fd6-d005bc939f2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/56f772e7-8053-42e7-9fd6-d005bc939f2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I hope to see some of you on the trail.
Thank you,
Chris

Friends,

18 days. That is it. This race is about more than a congressional seat. It is about the cost of living, the values that define us, and the kind of country we leave behind. It is about whether we send someone to Washington who actually fights for the people they serve—or leave in place someone who has spent the last four years doing the opposite. In a race this close, we need you on the ground with us for these final 18 days. Let’s leave everything on the field and bring the win home! Team Cait

| Friend,
---
I know you get bombarded with a lot of GOP emails claiming to be “URGENT.”
---
Then, when you click on them, it’s just another fundraising request before an arbitrary midnight deadline or some other spam.
---
This isn’t that – I promise. I don’t use the word “URGENT” lightly. When I put it in the subject line of an email, I mean it!
---
I’m calling this “URGENT” because it’s both time-sensitive and about the single most important thing that will decide the midterms: **__Actual votes that have been cast so far!__**
---
**According to mainstream media reports, early voting numbers across several states show a significant shift towards the Democrats compared to 2024.**
---
**_CNN_ : “Early voting data shows emerging signs of a Democratic advantage in the midterms” **
---
**“In Iowa, Democrats have made 67% of ballot requests, up from 54% at this point in 2024. In Pennsylvania, it’s 66%, up from 62%, and in Maine it’s 57%, up from 53%. And according to data from the North Carolina State Board of Elections, 42% of ballot requests are from Democrats, up from 36% at this point two years ago.”**
---
Now, I want to be completely honest with you, so I’m not going to get carried away and declare that all hope is lost or anything like that.
---
At the end of the day, this is a very small sample size – about a million votes!
---
BUT... President Trump was very clear about what it’s going to take to defy history and WIN the midterms when he instructed Republicans to vote like _HE_ is on the ballot:
---
**“Pretend, please, that I’m on the ballot. Just come and vote. It’s so important.”**
---
**_Unfortunately, this early voting data shows that so far, Republicans are _NOT_ listening to the President and voting like they did in 2024 when he was on the ballot!_**
---
The reality is that we’re LOCKED in a razor-tight battle for the House Majority.
---
Any shift towards Democrats – _even just among the earliest voters_ – could be the difference between SAVING our Majority or losing it to a bunch of crazy Far Left radicals who will IMPEACH the President and plunge America into political chaos.
---
_That’s why my TOP priority in the final weeks of the election is to verify as many GOP voters as possible – and do it as quickly as possible – so we can ERASE any early advantage the Democrats have._
---
We need to know not only __WHO__ we can count on to show up and cast a ballot for Republicans, but also __HOW__ and __WHEN__ you plan to cast your ballot.
---
**_As part of my efforts, I’m asking _YOU_ to complete your FINAL verification of your voter profile and ensure all information is 100% up to date for Election Day._**
---
[**Please, before midnight tonight, complete your FINAL verification.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---

[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---

[COMPLETE YOUR FINAL VERIFICATION >>](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---

Thank you,
---

---

Jim Jordan
